description: ASEAN Disaster Information Network (ADINet) is a data network run by ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on disaster management (AHA Centre). ADINet is the regional disaster-information portal of the AHA Centre with disaster event records, situation reports and hazard information for the ten ASEAN member states. Coverage: ASEAN member states. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as html; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("ASEAN Disaster Information Network") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support regional disaster loss and response studies in South-East Asia. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
